sentences.text: Kerala -LRB- -LSB- ˈkɛrələ -RSB- -RRB- historically known as Keralam , is an Indian state in South India on the Malabar Coast .	Indian state	States and union territories of India	South India	South India	Malabar Coast	Malabar Coast
It was formed on 1 November 1956 following the States Reorganisation Act by combining Malayalam-speaking regions .	Malayalam	Malayalam	States Reorganisation Act	States Reorganisation Act

Spread over 38863 km2 , it is bordered by Karnataka to the north and northeast , Tamil Nadu to the east and south , and the Lakshadweep Sea to the west .	Karnataka	Karnataka	Tamil Nadu	Tamil Nadu	Lakshadweep Sea	Lakshadweep Sea

With 33,387,677 inhabitants as per the 2011 Census , Kerala is the thirteenth-largest Indian state by population and is divided into 14 districts with the capital being Thiruvananthapuram .	Thiruvananthapuram	Thiruvananthapuram	14	Districts of Kerala	Indian state	States and union territories of India	2011 Census	2011 Census of India	thirteenth-largest Indian state by population	List of states of India by population	districts	Districts of India
Malayalam is the most widely spoken language and is also the official language of the state .	Malayalam	Malayalam
The region has been a prominent spice exporter since 3000 BCE .
The Chera Dynasty was the first prominent kingdom based in Kerala , though it frequently struggled against attacks by the neighbouring Cholas and Pandyas .	Chera Dynasty	Chera Dynasty
In the 15th century , the spice trade attracted Portuguese traders to Kerala , and paved the way for the European colonisation of India .	spice trade	spice trade	Portuguese	Portuguese people

After independence , Travancore and Cochin joined the Republic of India and Travancore-Cochin was given the status of a state in 1949 .	independence	Independence of India	Travancore	Travancore	Cochin	Cochin	Travancore-Cochin	Travancore-Cochin

In 1956 , Kerala state was formed by merging Malabar district , Travancore-Cochin -LRB- excluding four southern taluks of Kanyakumari district -RRB- , and the taluk of Kasaragod -LRB- now Kasaragod District -RRB- , South Kanara .	Travancore	Travancore	Cochin	Cochin	Travancore-Cochin	Travancore-Cochin	Malabar district	Malabar district	taluk	taluk	Kanyakumari district	Kanyakumari district	Kasaragod	Kasaragod	Kasaragod District	Kasaragod District	South Kanara	South Kanara

Kerala has the lowest positive population growth rate in India , 3.44 % ; highest Human Development Index -LRB- HDI -RRB- , 0.712 in 2015 ; the highest literacy rate , 93.91 % in the 2011 census ; the highest life expectancy , 77 years ; and the highest sex ratio , 1,084 women per 1000 men .	HDI	Human Development Index	Human Development Index	Human Development Index

The state has witnessed significant emigration , especially to Arab states of the Persian Gulf during the Gulf Boom of the 1970s and early 1980s , and its economy depends significantly on remittances from a large Malayali expatriate community .	Malayali	Malayali	Arab states of the Persian Gulf	Arab states of the Persian Gulf	Gulf Boom	Kerala Gulf diaspora#The Gulf Boom	remittances	remittances
Hinduism is practised by more than half of the population , followed by Islam and Christianity .	Hinduism	Hinduism	Islam	Islam	Christianity	Christianity
The culture is a synthesis of Aryan and Dravidian cultures , developed over millennia , under influences from other parts of India and abroad .	Aryan	Indo-Aryan peoples	Dravidian	South Indian culture
The production of pepper and natural rubber contributes significantly to the total national output .	pepper	Black pepper	natural rubber	natural rubber
In the agricultural sector , coconut , tea , coffee , cashew and spices are important .	coconut	coconut	tea	tea	coffee	coffee	cashew	cashew
The state 's coastline extends for 595 km , and around 1.1 million people in the state are dependent on the fishery industry which contributes 3 % to the state 's income .

The state has the highest media exposure in India with newspapers publishing in nine languages , mainly English and Malayalam .	Malayalam	Malayalam	highest media exposure in India	Indian states ranking by media exposure

Kerala is one of the prominent tourist destinations of India , with backwaters , beaches , Ayurvedic tourism and tropical greenery as its major attractions .	backwaters	Kerala Backwaters	Ayurvedic tourism	Ayurveda	tropical	tropical
